section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. All data for this comparison were collected at the Harbor Street Patients.

Table 2. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Systolic drop | 9.0 | 4.5 | 350 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Alvenor | Systolic drop | 6.8 | 3.4 | 350 |

The same layout is used for all arms and measures here.
